theorem QOU.CentralExtension.Cech.bring_kummer_trivial_iff {X : Type} [TopologicalSpace X] (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] {Cov : CechGerbe.Cover ⊤ → Prop} (𝒰 : CechGerbe.Cover ⊤) (h𝒰 : Cov 𝒰) (γ : CategoryTheory.PresheafOfGroups.OneCocycle (contPresheaf X Circle) 𝒰.obj) (ξ : CategoryTheory.PresheafOfGroups.OneCochain (contPresheaf X (Multiplicative ℝ)) 𝒰.obj) (hξ : IsRealLift γ ξ) [D : KummerSurfaceData X n Cov] (hχ : KummerSurfaceData.deg n (CechGerbe.cechClass 𝒰 h𝒰 (chernCocycle γ ξ hξ)) = -6) :

(∃ (𝒲 : CechGerbe.Cover ⊤) (_ : Cov 𝒲) (ρ : 𝒲.Refines 𝒰) (η : CategoryTheory.PresheafOfGroups.OneCocycle (contPresheaf X Circle) 𝒲.obj), ∀ (j j' : 𝒲.ι) ⦃T : TopologicalSpace.Opens X⦄ (a : T ⟶ 𝒲.obj j) (b : T ⟶ 𝒲.obj j'), η.ev j j' a b ^ n = (pullOneCocycle 𝒰.obj ρ.r ρ.f γ).ev j j' a b) ↔ ↑n ∣ χ
